rows.label: qst630406_msg0001
rows.name: Damn... What strength...

rows.label: qst630406_msg0002
rows.name: So the three of us weren't enough...

rows.label: qst630406_msg0003
rows.name:
Go ahead. Boil us or roast us, do what
you like.

rows.label: qst630406_msg0004
rows.name: But we won't give up any information!

rows.label: qst630406_msg0005
rows.name: So that is what happened...

rows.label: qst630406_msg0006
rows.name:
So there is a cease-fire with
Superbia...

rows.label: qst630406_msg0007
rows.name: And you came to bring us back...

rows.label: qst630406_msg0008
rows.name:
We're grateful, but there is one thing
we still have to do.

rows.label: qst630406_msg0009
rows.name:
On your way after us, did you see the
grave of one of our comrades?

rows.label: qst630406_msg0010
rows.name:
He was our comrade... and our
leader...

rows.label: qst630406_msg0011
rows.name: It's Bonavento's grave.

rows.label: qst630406_msg0012
rows.name:
As you probably know, mercenaries
honor the dead by burying them where
they fell...

rows.label: qst630406_msg0013
rows.name:
And avenging them is another part of
how we honor them.

rows.label: qst630406_msg0014
rows.name:
That's why we were chasing the ones
who killed Bonavento, but...

rows.label: qst630406_msg0015
rows.name:
Shamefully, we could not corner
them...

rows.label: qst630406_msg0016
rows.name:
We lost to them with four people, so
the odds were worse with three...

rows.label: qst630406_msg0017
rows.name:
So we were thinking of heading back to
camp for now.

rows.label: qst630406_msg0018
rows.name: You'll avenge him for us?

rows.label: qst630406_msg0019
rows.name: Thank you...

rows.label: qst630406_msg0020
rows.name:
Bonavento's killer should be farther
ahead.

rows.label: qst630406_msg0021
rows.name: We'll wait near the grave.

rows.label: qst630406_msg0022
rows.name:
We'll hope for good news... But don't
be reckless enough to get yourself
killed.
